sapubbabhāga.p: [ saha + pubbabhāga ] (ti) Google Translate Which is for the front: (a) With metaphors. (b) with noble path deeds. (c) with the merits of karma. (d) with worldly benefits.

sapubbadevata.p: [ saha + pubbadevatā + a ] (ti) Google Translate The one who is with the first house spirit. (With the house god who was the first offering.)

သားနှင့် တကွသော။
DOP: putta putra m. S I 42, 16* (~o pavadataṃ varo; Spk I 98, 20 : rājakulamajjhādīsu pavadantānaṃ ~o varo, so hi mātāpitūnaṃ anatthāvahaṃ na vadati); 210, 12* (piyo loke sako ~o); A III 43, 22* (pañcaṭṭhānāni sampassaṃ ~am icchanti paṇḍitā); Dhp 288 (na santi ~ā tāṇāya); Ud 5, 29 (eso te samaṇa ~o posa nan ti); 17, 33 (iccheyyāmāhaṃ bhagavā aññāni pi evarūpāni satta ~ānī ti; Ud-a 157, 11 foll.: aññe pi evarūpe satta ~e ti vattabbe liṅgavipallāsena vuttaṃ); It 62, 20 (tayo ’me bhikkhave ~ā … atijāto anujāto avajāto ti); Sn 35 (na ~am iccheyya kuto sahāyaṃ eko care khaggavisāṇakappo); 38 (~esu dāresu ca yā apekhā; Pj II 76, 5 : puttadhītubhariyāsu); 149 (mātā yathā niyaṃ ~aṃ āyusā ekaputtam anurakkhe); 255 (yasmiṃ ca seti urasīva ~o sa ve mitto); 858 (na tassa ~ā pasavo khettaṃ vatthuṃ ca vijjati, so read with Be, Ce, Se ); Vv 83:11 (ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā ~o kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ); Pv 6:3 (pañca ~āni … vijāyitvāna); 42:5 (thaṇḍile pattaṃ bhinditvā hasamāno apakkami rañño Kitavass’ ahaṃ ~o, kiṃ maṃ bhikkhu karissasi); Th 475 (kicchā laddho ayaṃ ~o … imaṃ dadāma te nātha); Thī 312 (petāni bhoti ~āni khādamānā tuvaṃ pure); Ja II 19, 4 (tassa pana hatthissa ~o sabbaseto hatthājānīyapotako atthi); 39, 12 (apare pan’ assa dve haṃsapotakā ~ā ahesuṃ); III 50, 13* (tātā ti ~o vadamāno kampeti hadayaṃ pitu); V 279, 13 (avassaṃ ettikāsu itthīsu ekā puññavatī ~aṃ labhissatī ti); 509, 22* (na te ~ā ye na bharanti jiṇṇaṃ); VI 133, 2* (~ehi deva yajitabbaṃ; 133, 6´ : attano jātehi piyaputtehi c’ eva piyadhītāhi ca); 290, 14* (āmantaya vammadharāni … ~āni; 290, 20´ : mama ~e ca dhītaro ca); (cattāro ~ā attajo ~o khettajo ~o dinnako ~o antevāsiko ~o); Ap 330, 29 (bhariyā me kālakatā ~o sīvathikaṃ gato); 355, 13 (kiṃ me ~ehi dārehi rajjena sakalena ca); Cp 3:2:1 (kāmito dayito ~o); Mil 75, 14 foll. (api ca mātusadiso vā ~o hoti mātupakkho vā pitusadiso vā ~o hoti pitupakkho vā ti); 287, 29 (~ā mahārāja loke bandhanaṃ); Vism 567, 27 (pitito nāmavasena ~o); Mp I 258, 8 (Rāhulasāmaṇero pitu anucchaviko ~o ti); 399, 7 (rūpūpajīviniyo ca nāma vijātakāle sace ~o hoti chaḍḍenti sace dhītā jagganti); Dhp-a I 88, 25 (Upatissagāmake jeṭṭhakulassa °-ttā Upatisso ti nāmaṃ kariṃsu); II 273, 17 (yassa gehe ~o vā dhītā vā na koci matapubbo ti); Ud-a 276, 14 (vijātamātuyā nāma virūpo pi ~o surūpo viya manāpo hoti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee piyamanāpo hoti); Pj II 79, 3 (deva kulavaṃsānupālako ~o icchitabbo attaje avijjamāne khettajo pi kulavaṃsadharo hotī ti); Th-a III 127, 13 (rañño ekā dhītā va atthi ~o natthi, arājakaṃ rajjaṃ nassati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee arājikaṃ rajjaṃ na nandati); Nidd-a I 258, 3 (puṃ tāyati rakkhatī ti ~o); Sadd 402, 11 foll. (°-cittaṃ upaṭṭhapessatī ti ~o me ayan ti evaṃ gehasitapemavasena cittaṃ upaṭṭhapessati); Dhp-a IV 231, 15 (satthā na bhikkhave mama ~o Aṅgulimālo bhāyati … ti vatvā); — 3. a member of a group; a follower; an apprentice; — ifc see ugga- ( sv ugga 2 ), kammāra-, dāsa- ( sv dāsa 1 ), dāsaka-, nigaṇṭha-, para-, ludda-, sakya-; — °- kate , for the sake of the child; Thī 303 (na maṃ ~e jammi puna-r-āvattayissasi, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be °-katte; Thī-a 214, 33 : ~e ti °-kāraṇā, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se °-katte ti); — °- khādinī , ( m ) f ( n )., who eats her children; Thī-a 219, 21 (loke hi yassā itthiyā jātajātā puttā maranti taṃ garahantā ~inī ti ādiṃ vadanti); — ifc see pañca-; — °- giddhi(n) , mfn. , loving, eagerly longing for, one’s son; Ja VI 584, 1* (pitaraṃ ~inaṃ); Vism 665, 14 (ekā kira ~inī itthī); — °- jīva , m. , a kind of tree (Putranjiva Roxburghii ?); Ja VI 530, 4* (~ā ca kakudhā; 531, 7´ : ~ā ti mahānigrodhā, Be so; Se mahānigrodharukkhā; Ce, Ee omit ); — °- dāra , m.n. sg. and pl. , wife and children; wives and children; Abh 421 (mahāpariccāgo … ~ānaṃ); Vin III 244, 32 (attanā pi na yāpeti ~ā pi ’ssa kilamanti); IV 104, 21 (ye mayaṃ ājīvassa hetu ~assa kāraṇā senāya āgacchāmā ti); D III 66, 4 (~aṃ ca posehi); 192, 1* (~ā disā pacchā); A I 206, 22 foll. (jānāti kho pan’ assa ~o ayaṃ mayhaṃ bhattā ti so pi jānāti ayaṃ mayhaṃ ~o ti); Khp 5:5 (mātāpitu-upaṭṭhānaṃ ~assa saṅgaho; Pj I 138, 8 : attano jātā puttā pi dhītaro pi puttā tv eva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti dārā ti vīsatiyā bhariyānaṃ yā kāci bhariyā, puttā ca dārā ca ~aṃ) = Sn 262; Thī 112 (~āni posentā dhanaṃ vindanti māṇavā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee mānavā); Ja VI 136, 15 (ayye putto vo ~e māretvā yaññaṃ yajitukāmo ti); 511, 4* (Vessantaro rājā … ādāya ~aṃ ca Vaṅkaṃ pāyāsi pabbataṃ); Vism 502, 13* (vippavāsasatādīnaṃ ~ehi attano); Mil 274, 21 foll. (bhante Nāgasena, sabbe va bodhisattā ~aṃ denti, udāhu Vessantaren’ eva raññā ~aṃ dinnan ti); Sv 850, 20 (antojanasaṅkhātaṃ tava ~aṃ sīlasaṃvare patiṭṭhāpehi); — saputtadāra, m ( fn )., with one’s wife and children; Vin III 160, 29 ; M II 167, 20 ; Pv 38:48; Ja V 219, 17* (dāso ahaṃ tuyha saputtadāro); — °- naṭṭha , mfn. , deprived of his son; who has lost his son; Ja II 183, 10* (dehi ~a phālanaṭṭhassa phālaṃ; 183, 24´ : ambho naṭṭhaputtapurisa); — °- natta , iic , [putta + natta(r)], sons and grandsons; Sp 100, 20 (~-paramparāya); Dhp-a I 408, 7 (~-panattasantānavasena); 416, 13 (~-parivutā); — °- nattakā , m.pl. , sons and grandsons; Sp 1011, 1 (~esu); Spk III 32, 30 (~ānaṃ dārakānaṃ pacchato caritabbaṃ hoti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pūtigandhakānaṃ pacchato caritabbo hoti, perhaps wr ); — °- paputtakā , m.pl. , sons and grandsons; M II 78, 8 (Ps III 312, 13 : puttā ca puttaputtā cā ti); Mhv 2:5; — °- pema , n. , affection, love, for a son, for one’s child; Vin I 82, 38 (~aṃ bhante chaviṃ chindati); Ja IV 36, 7* (~ā na idha par’ atthi kiñci); Ap 532, 18 (paṇāmaṃ te karissaṃ ~asā, Ce, Ee so; Be putta-uttame; Se puttapemahaṃ); 555, 22 (me ~asā); Mp III 310, 8 (dhītaraṃ vā puttaṃ vā jātaṃ disvā ~aṃ puttassādo uppajjati); — °- matā , ( m ) f ( n )., one whose children are (as good as) dead; M I 524, 1 (ime pan’ ājīvikā ~āya puttā; Ps III 235, 6 : ājīvikā matā nāma tesaṃ mātā ~ā hoti); — see °-hata below; — °- matta , m. , like a son; who is the age or has the status of one’s son; M I 460, 14 (ime pan’ amhākaṃ ~ā maññe nattamattā maññe) = A II 124, 5 ; Ja VI 433, 27´ ; — °- va(t) , mf ( n )., who has a son or sons or children; S IV 249, 12 (°-vatī assan ti); Thī 300 (maṃ °-vatiṃ santiṃ kassa ohāya gacchasi); Pj II 44, 14 (°-vā puggalo); — °- sañjīvana , mfn. , making my son live; Ap 566, 6 (avocaṃ dehi bhesajjaṃ ~an ti bho); — °- sama , mfn. , equal to (that for) a son; S I 6, 17* (natthi ~aṃ pemaṃ; Spk I 32, 29 foll.: virūpe pi hi attano puttake suvaṇṇabimbakaṃ viya maññati … °-pemena samaṃ pemaṃ nāma natthī ti vuttaṃ hoti); — °- hata , mfn. , whose children are (as good as) dead; Ja I 355, 8* (athāgamā ~āya putto; 355, 13´ : hataputtāya putto nillajjo ti attho); Spk I 338, 18 (gaṇhatha ~āya putte ti, Be, Ce so; Se °-matāya; Ee suttahatāya sutte ti) = 346, 19 ( Be, Ce so; Se °-matāya; Ee suttahatāya sutte ti); — aputta , m. , not a son; not an heir; Ja V 468, 6 (atha naṃ vinicchayaṃ netvā ~-bhāvaṃ katvā nīharāpesi); VI 472, 3´ (ahaṃ tava puttaṃ ca ~aṃ ca jānāmi); Sv 953, 7 (mātāpitaro … micchāpaṭipanne dārake vinicchayaṃ patvā ~e karonti, Be, Se so; Ce aputtake; Ee aputtakaṃ) ≠ Spk III 160, 34 (ayaṃ amhākaṃ ~o ti paribāhiraṃ karonti) = Mp II 65, 6 ; Mp I 429, 1 (esa taṃ ~aṃ karissāmī ti pakkosati, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee aputtakaṃ); Sadd 587, 17 (~aṃ puttam iva ācarati puttīyati); — duputta , dupputta , m. , a bad son; Vism 494, 28 (kucchitaṃ hi puttaṃ dupputto ti vadanti) = Paṭis-a 54, 27 (duputto ti) = Vibh-a 84, 3 (duputto ti); — niputta , mf ( n )., without children, childless; Thī-a 182, 25 (ahaṃ bahuputtā hutvā ~ā jātā ti); — saputta , mf ( n )., with one’s son(s); with one’s children; D I 110, 23 (esāhaṃ … ~o sabhariyo sapariso …); Ja II 29, 24 (~āya tāya saddhiṃ samaggavāsaṃ vasi); IV 147, 28 (ten’ assā ahaṃ ~āya parihāraṃ acchinditvā); VI 175, 5* ; Dhp-a I 48, 8 (~aṃ taṃ khādituṃ labheyyan ti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se saputtakaṃ); Ud-a 127, 12 (bhagavā ~āya mātuyā arogabhāvaṃ āsiṃsanto, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee sahaputtāya tassā); — see also atraja, antevāsika, aputtaka 1 , ekaputtikā ( sv eka ), khettaja, dinnaka, nipputtaka, sakyaputtiya ( sv sakya ), saputtaka 1 .

DOP: puttaka m. ( pl. nom./acc. ~e ~āni) [ S. putraka], a little son (of men or birds or animals); a dear son; a dear child; pl. also: little children; dear children; Th 82 (yena yena subhikkhāni … tena ~a gacchassu; Th-a I 188, 1 : ~ā ti [mātā] anukampantī taṃ ālapati); Thī 430 (atha maṃ bhaṇati tāto idh’ eva ~a carāhi taṃ dhammaṃ, Ee so; Be, Ce tvaṃ dhammaṃ; Se puttike; Thī-a 247, 31 foll.: sāmaññavohārena dhītaraṃ anukampento ālapati); Ja III 174, 27* (mā me vadhī ~e dubbalāya); 175, 19* (vadhissāmi te laṭukike ~āni); 213, 25 (migapotako vaḍḍhanto abhirūpo ahosi … tāpaso taṃ attano ~aṃ katvā pariharati); 268, 24 (sakuṇā āgantvā ~e apassantā … viravanti); VI 509, 29* (piyā me ~ā deva Jāli Kaṇhājinā ubho); Ap 534, 10 (tena nibbātum icchāmi anumaññatha ~ā); Spk II 147, 23 (mātāpitaro hi kadāci ~e evaṃ pi vadanti corā te khaṇḍākhaṇḍikaṃ karontū ti, uppalapattaṃ pi ca nesaṃ upari patantaṃ na icchanti); Mhv 22:69 (Gotamo nāma thero ca paṭigaṇhātu ~aṃ); Sadd 803, 19 (ko … anukampatthe: ~o); — ifc see ayya-, pitā- ( sv pita[r] ); — aputtaka , m. , not a son, not an heir; Sv 953, 7 (mātāpitaro … micchāpaṭipanne dārake vinicchayaṃ patvā ~e karonti, Ce so; Be, Se aputte; Ee ~aṃ); Mp I 429, 1 (esa taṃ ~aṃ karissāmī ti pakkosati, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se aputtaṃ); — saputtaka , mf ( n )., with one’s son(s); with one’s children; Ja V 107, 1* (evaṃ khajjatu Pañcālo hato yuddhe ~o); Cp-a 118, 35 (mahāsatto … taṃ ~aṃ manussalokaṃ pāpesi); — see also puttikā, saputtaka 3 .
